title: Wire EDM Gap Fill — 91→100 Production Hardening
completion_note: 11 of 15 U-WGAP units complete. 4 INFRA-blocked units (electrical/scheduling infrastructure) out of WEDM scope — noted in roadmap-index.json. All in-scope gaps closed.
philosophy: Close the 5 structural gaps identified by 10-role scrutiny audit. Each gap maps to a specific role deficit. Prioritized by production impact for JM Die Monday testing.

gap_analysis.note: 100 requires machine I/O integration (electrical safety) and scheduling infrastructure — those are INFRA-MS0 dependencies, not WEDM scope

gaps.title: Imperial/Inch G-code Output
gaps.description: All 5 controller posts hardcode G21 (metric). Coordinates never converted to inches. Feed rates inconsistent. JM Die runs inch mode on Mitsubishi FA-10S.
gaps.root_cause: formatCoord() always outputs mm. No G20 header emission. Only H-offset converted in Mitsubishi post.

gaps.title: Wire Break Recovery Logic
gaps.description: System predicts wire break risk but has zero recovery logic. No backup distance calculation, no restart markers for break recovery, no auto-retry in G-code.
gaps.root_cause: Wire break is predicted (EDMCuttingParamFlushEngine) but no recovery path exists. Tribal knowledge tip wedm-kb-003 documents the manual process but it's not automated.

gaps.title: Machine Scheduling/Capacity Integration
gaps.description: No machine availability check before promising delivery. No queue depth, no reservation, no conflict detection.
gaps.root_cause: Requires scheduling infrastructure (CapacityPlanningEngine exists for milling but not wired for WEDM).
gaps.note: Partially blocked by INFRA — but basic queue awareness can be added

gaps.title: STEP/IGES Geometry Import Flow
gaps.description: Routes advertise STEP/IGES support but P2P pipeline only handles DXF and pre-parsed contours. StepImportEngine exists but not wired into WEDM flow.
gaps.root_cause: photo-to-program route checks for dxf_content and image_base64 but not step_content or iges_content.

gaps.title: Electrical Safety Active Checks
gaps.description: No dielectric level validation, no tank interlock status, no emergency stop handling, no fire suppression verification. Setup sheet has warnings but no active checks.
gaps.root_cause: Requires machine I/O integration for true active checks. Can add pre-flight checklist validation as intermediate step.

units.title: Imperial coordinate conversion in formatCoord()
units.description: Add units parameter to formatCoord(). When imperial: divide all X/Y/U/V coordinates by 25.4, emit G20 instead of G21 in header, convert feed rates to IPM.
exit_criteria: G20 emitted in header when units='imperial'
All X/Y/U/V coordinates output in inches

units.title: Imperial support across all 5 controller posts
units.description: Apply imperial conversion to Fanuc, Sodick, Makino, AgieCharmilles posts (Mitsubishi done in U-WGAP01). Each post gets G20/G21 header and coordinate conversion.
exit_criteria: All 5 posts emit correct G20/G21 based on units parameter
New test: imperial output produces valid inch-mode G-code

units.title: Wire break recovery: backup distance calculation
units.description: New function calculateBreakRecovery(breakPosition, passNumber, material) → {backup_mm, retry_count, reduced_params}. Based on tribal knowledge tip wedm-kb-003 (2mm behind break) with material-specific adjustments.
exit_criteria: Reduced parameters (20% power reduction) for restart

units.title: Wire break recovery: G-code restart markers
units.description: Emit Mitsubishi-specific restart markers in G-code at every pass boundary. On wire break, controller can jump to nearest restart marker and back up by calculated distance. Uses N-number restart convention.
exit_criteria: Restart markers (N-numbers with comments) at every pass start
Break recovery block with M21/M20 re-thread sequence
G-code comment documenting backup distance per restart point

units.title: WEDM machine queue awareness
units.description: Wire CapacityPlanningEngine's machine_availability check into EDMFeasibilityEngine. When checking delivery feasibility, query machine queue for estimated available slot. Not full scheduling — just 'machine busy until X, your job takes Y hours'.
exit_criteria: If machine has queued jobs, estimated_start_time is populated
delivery_hours check accounts for queue wait time
Graceful fallback if no queue data available

units.title: WEDM machine reservation (book-ahead)
units.description: New dispatcher action wedm_reserve_machine that creates a time slot reservation for a WEDM job. Simple file-based reservation (JSON in data/state/). Checks for conflicts before booking.

units.title: STEP file import → WEDM contour extraction
units.description: Wire StepImportEngine output into WEDMPrintToProgramEngine. Route /photo-to-program and /gcode-export-from-dxf accept step_content parameter. Extract 2D profiles from 3D STEP solid for wire EDM path planning.
exit_criteria: step_content parameter accepted in P2P pipeline
Fallback error message if STEP parsing fails

units.title: IGES file import → WEDM contour extraction
units.description: Same as U-WGAP07 but for IGES files. Wire IGESImportEngine output into P2P pipeline.
exit_criteria: iges_content parameter accepted in P2P pipeline
Both STEP and IGES paths tested

units.title: Pre-flight safety checklist engine
units.description: New pre-flight checklist that the operator must acknowledge before the machine runs a PRISM-generated program. Checklist items are dynamic based on job parameters (thickness, material, taper, submerged mode). Not machine I/O — human verification gate.
exit_criteria: Includes: dielectric level, interlock, wire path, tank level, fire suppression

units.title: Safety interlock simulation in G-code comments
units.description: Add safety verification comments to generated G-code. Before M84 (power on), emit comment block reminding operator to verify interlocks. Before M78 (tank fill), verify tank valve position. These are comments, not M-codes — controller ignores them but operator sees them on screen.
exit_criteria: Safety verification comments before M84, M78, M20
Material-specific caution comments (carbide → wire type, titanium → alpha case)
Pre-cut checklist summary in program header comments

units.title: Comprehensive test suite for all gap fills
units.description: 50+ new tests covering: imperial output validation, wire break recovery params, machine availability check, STEP/IGES input paths, pre-flight checklist generation, safety comments in G-code.
exit_criteria: Break recovery tests verify backup distance
No regression in existing 487 WEDM tests

forge_triple.protective_hook: wedm-production-gate — blocks program download if pre-flight checklist not acknowledged
mcp_actions: wedm_plan_break_recovery — calculates wire break recovery parameters

score_projection.theoretical_max: 98/100 — remaining 2 pts require machine I/O integration (INFRA dependency)

risks.risk: Imperial conversion breaks existing inch-mode programs at JM Die
risks.mitigation: Test against real JM Die NC files before deploying. Keep metric as default.

risks.risk: StepImportEngine may not handle all STEP AP214/AP242 variants
risks.mitigation: Graceful fallback with descriptive error. DXF remains primary path.

risks.risk: Wire break recovery backup distance varies by controller firmware version
risks.mitigation: Make backup distance configurable with sensible default (2mm from wedm-kb-003).
